_comment: Example hooks block for agent-monitor. Copy the 'hooks' section into your project's .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json for personal/gitignored). Adjust the absolute paths to match where you copied agent-monitor/ — typically <your-project>/.claude/agent-monitor/. The selflearn.py SessionStart entry is the Layer 2 cross-session memory: it reads memory.json (written by reporter.py) and injects a short advisory about anti-patterns from prior sessions. To disable injection without losing data: touch <absolute-path-to>/agent-monitor/selflearn.disabled.
